questions.question: Who did God promise to send ahead of the Israelites to protect them on their journey?
God told the Israelites not to defy the angel He was sending ahead of them. What reason did He give?

answers.text: The angel will not forgive rebellion
The angel will turn back to Egypt
The angel will go to another people

questions.question: What did God say He would send ahead of the Israelites to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out?
What did God tell the Israelites to do with the gods of the nations living in the land?

answers.text: Demolish them and smash their sacred stones
Leave them standing and stay away from them
Carry them off and keep them as plunder
